title: Determination of sexual dimorphism with CBCT images of the frontal sinus using a predictive formula and an artificial neural network.
summary: On CBCT frontal-sinus measurements, an ANN estimated sex in a Brazilian forensic sample of 1,000 scans (800 model-development, 200 test) with 76% accuracy versus 73.5% for the predictive formula; sensitivity was lower, limiting scope to this sample and use.
ai_technology: ANN classifies sex from frontal-sinus dimensions selected using regression analysis.
